responsibility: This file provides the OpenVMS C-family frontend glue for target-specific source semantics. It registers and implements VMS pragmas such as standard/nostandard, member alignment, extern_model, extern_prefix, message, and pointer-size control; updates frontend state like maximum_field_alignment, default pointer mode, and extern handling policy; installs VMS module-style include directory construction for standard system headers; and applies C frontend option overrides and predefined-version defaults used when parsing C on VMS.
